question_en: List the sections that reference section 5.4.3.1 of spec 38.321 (incoming references).
original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.321'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section {sectionNumber:'5.4.3.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH s, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (ref:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(s) RETURN ref.sectionId, ref.sectionTitle ORDER BY ref.sectionId
reference_query:
MATCH (anchor:Section {sectionNumber: '5.4.3.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.321'})
MATCH (ref:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(anchor)
RETURN DISTINCT ref.sectionId AS sectionId
